datacolumn.scope: Read FLOAT_DATA or the real part of DATA or CORRECTED_DATA through the data, float_data and corrected selectors.

antenna.scope: select data by antenna name or ID, e.g. "PM03"

field.scope: select data by field IDs and names, e.g. "3C2*" (""=all)

spw.scope: select data by IF IDs (spectral windows), e.g. "3,5,7" (""=all)

timerange.scope: select data by time range, e.g. "09:14:0~09:54:0" (""=all) (see examples in help)

scan.scope: select data by scan numbers, e.g. "21~23" (""=all)

pol.scope: select data by polarization IDs, e.g. "XX,YY" (""=all)

intent.scope: select data by observational intent, e.g. "*ON_SOURCE*" (""=all)

timespan.scope: span the timebin across "scan", "state", "field", or a combination of them (e.g., "scan,state")

fitmode.scope: Use explicit component counts and channel ranges or detect lines automatically.

nfit.scope: list of number of lines to fit in maskline region.

minwidth.scope: the minimum channel width to detect as a line

edge.scope: channels to drop at beginning and end of spectrum

overwrite.scope: overwrite the output file if already exists

behaviors.title: Select single-dish spectra
behaviors.scope: Apply CASA autocorrelation, field, time, scan, correlation, intent and spectral-window selection. Use channel ranges as masks on the original spectra.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Fit and report spectral lines
behaviors.scope: Fit Gaussian and Lorentzian emission and absorption components. Return channel centers, peaks, widths and residual covariance errors as nested Python lists.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Average selected integrations and hands
behaviors.scope: Combine selected integrations and time-span axes or average parallel hands, using channel weights when present. An attached fit_line retains its averaging settings until reopened or closed.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Detect line ranges
behaviors.scope: Use the CASA clipped-MAD line finder to choose fit ranges. Omit spectra with no detected line in automatic mode.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Publish interoperable fit products
behaviors.scope: Write the optional tab-separated fit report and the direct tool text and empty selected MeasurementSet. Switch to Stokes I metadata when requested by the attached tool.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

decisions.record: Single-dish line fitting can exceed its time bin on descending rows
decisions.inputs: A one-second fit bin on four integrations provided in descending physical order.
decisions.casa: The iterator fits one combined spectrum per hand.
decisions.ours: Chronological ordering yields four fitted spectra per hand in either physical row order.
decisions.rationale: The bin duration applies to integration times. Fit products agree with CASA on the chronological input.
decisions.impact: A reordered MeasurementSet gives the same fitted time bins.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Single-dish polarization averaging can abort for one selected hand
decisions.inputs: Select YY on an XX/YY setup and request geometric averaging.
decisions.casa: The iterator can abort while indexing the original pair.
decisions.ours: With no selected pair, fit the selected hand unchanged.
decisions.rationale: The selected correlation is the only available eligible spectrum.
decisions.impact: The call returns the equivalent fit of the selected hand.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Single-dish line fitting aborts for negative component counts
decisions.casa: An unsigned component allocation can abort the process.
decisions.ours: Raise a runtime error before allocating a fit.
decisions.rationale: A component count cannot be negative.
decisions.impact: The caller can correct the list without losing the session.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: A failed line fit can delete the previous report
decisions.inputs: Enable overwrite for an existing fit report and supply a mismatched component count.
decisions.casa: The earlier report is removed before the error.
decisions.ours: Keep the report until the replacement has been fitted and written.
decisions.rationale: An incomplete fit cannot replace an existing product.
decisions.impact: The caller keeps the earlier report after a failed fit.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

paired.kind: Public task and tool spectral fits, uncertainties and MeasurementSet interchange
paired.scope: All 21 task arguments, all 15 fit_line arguments, independent profile and covariance fits, averaging, CSV and tabular results, and the empty direct-tool MS opened in both readers.
paired.result: The paired and analytic comparisons pass for selected noisy single and joint components, including the reviewed direct-channel weights, count separators, symlink report and contended publication retry.
